column1: legislate|/ˈledʒɪsleɪt/|v.|立法；通过法律规定|六级|legislate|legislate for::为……立法;legislate against::立法禁止|The government plans to legislate against unfair practices.::政府计划立法禁止不公平的做法。|It is difficult to legislate for every possible situation.::很难通过立法涵盖每一种可能的情况。

legislation|/ˌledʒɪsˈleɪʃən/|n.|法律；立法|六级|legislate|introduce legislation::提出立法;environmental legislation::环境立法|The proposal would require new legislation.::这一提案需要新的立法。|Environmental legislation sets limits on certain kinds of pollution.::环境法规对某些污染作出了限制。

legislative|/ˈledʒɪsleɪtɪv/|adj.|立法的；立法机关的|六级|legislate|a legislative body::立法机构;the legislative process::立法程序|The committee reviewed the proposal during the legislative process.::委员会在立法程序中审查了这项提案。|A legislative body debates and votes on proposed laws.::立法机构对拟议法律进行辩论和表决。

democracy|/dɪˈmɑːkrəsi/|n.|民主；民主制度|六级|democracy|representative democracy::代议制民主;participatory democracy::参与式民主|The course compares different forms of democracy.::这门课程比较不同形式的民主制度。|Public debate plays a role in a functioning democracy.::公共辩论在正常运转的民主制度中发挥作用。

democratic|/ˌdeməˈkrætɪk/|adj.|民主的；按民主方式进行的|六级|democracy|a democratic process::民主程序;democratic participation::民主参与|The organization chose its leader through a democratic process.::这个组织通过民主程序选出了领导者。|The discussion focused on democratic participation at the local level.::讨论集中于地方层面的民主参与。

autonomy|/ɔːˈtɑːnəmi/|n.|自主权；自治|六级|autonomy|local autonomy::地方自治;professional autonomy::专业自主权|The reform gave local schools greater autonomy.::改革赋予了地方学校更大的自主权。|Professional autonomy comes with responsibility for decisions.::专业自主权也意味着要对决定负责。

autonomous|/ɔːˈtɑːnəməs/|adj.|自主的；自治的；能自主运行的|六级|autonomy|an autonomous region::自治区;an autonomous system::自主系统|The team designed an autonomous system for monitoring water quality.::团队设计了一套自主运行的水质监测系统。|The institution remains autonomous in its academic decisions.::这所机构在学术决策方面保持自主。

participatory|/pɑːrˈtɪsəpətɔːri/|adj.|参与式的；鼓励参与的|六级|civic-practices|a participatory approach::参与式方法;participatory planning::参与式规划|The project uses a participatory approach to community planning.::这个项目采用参与式方法进行社区规划。|A participatory process gives residents a chance to contribute.::参与式程序为居民提供了贡献意见的机会。

collaborate|/kəˈlæbəreɪt/|v.|合作；共同开展工作|六级|collaborate|collaborate with::与……合作;collaborate on::合作开展|The two laboratories will collaborate on the new study.::这两个实验室将合作开展新的研究。|Students collaborate with local artists to create the exhibition.::学生与当地艺术家合作创作展览作品。

collaboration|/kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃən/|n.|合作；协作成果|六级|collaborate|in collaboration with::与……合作;close collaboration::密切合作|The report was written in collaboration with several universities.::这份报告由几所大学合作撰写。|Close collaboration helped the teams solve the problem.::密切合作帮助这些团队解决了问题。

coordinate|/koʊˈɔːrdɪneɪt/|v.|协调；组织配合|六级|coordinate|coordinate efforts::协调各方努力;coordinate with::与……协调|Someone needs to coordinate the work of the different teams.::需要有人来协调不同团队的工作。|We will coordinate with local groups before the event.::活动开始前，我们会与当地团体协调。

coordination|/koʊˌɔːrdɪˈneɪʃən/|n.|协调；配合；协调能力|六级|coordinate|close coordination::密切协调;hand-eye coordination::手眼协调|The project requires close coordination between the two departments.::这个项目需要两个部门之间的密切协调。|The game helps children develop hand-eye coordination.::这个游戏帮助儿童发展手眼协调能力。

integrate|/ˈɪntɪɡreɪt/|v.|整合；使融入；结合|六级|integrate|integrate into::融入;integrate with::与……结合|The new service will integrate with the existing system.::这项新服务将与现有系统整合。|The program helps new students integrate into school life.::这个项目帮助新生融入学校生活。

integration|/ˌɪntɪˈɡreɪʃən/|n.|整合；融合；融入|六级|integrate|system integration::系统集成;social integration::社会融入|System integration can reduce repeated data entry.::系统集成可以减少重复的数据录入。|The study explores factors that support social integration.::这项研究探讨有助于社会融入的因素。

inclusion|/ɪnˈkluːʒən/|n.|包括；纳入；包容|六级|civic-practices|social inclusion::社会包容;the inclusion of::纳入……|The design encourages the inclusion of different viewpoints.::这一设计鼓励纳入不同的观点。|Social inclusion means giving more people a chance to participate.::社会包容意味着让更多人有机会参与。

exclusion|/ɪkˈskluːʒən/|n.|排除；不包括；排斥|六级|civic-practices|social exclusion::社会排斥;the exclusion of::排除……|The report discusses the causes of social exclusion.::报告讨论了社会排斥的成因。|The exclusion of these cases must be explained clearly.::必须清楚解释排除这些案例的原因。

diverse|/daɪˈvɜːrs/|adj.|多种多样的；不同的|六级|diverse|diverse backgrounds::不同背景;a diverse range::多种多样的范围|The course attracts students from diverse backgrounds.::这门课程吸引了不同背景的学生。|The region supports a diverse range of wildlife.::这一地区养育着多种多样的野生动物。

diversity|/daɪˈvɜːrsəti/|n.|多样性；差异|六级|diverse|cultural diversity::文化多样性;a diversity of::多种多样的|The festival celebrates the cultural diversity of the city.::这个节日展示并赞颂这座城市的文化多样性。|A diversity of opinions can improve the discussion.::多样的意见能够改善讨论。

equity|/ˈekwəti/|n.|公平；权益；股权|六级|civic-practices|educational equity::教育公平;equity in a company::公司的股权|The policy aims to improve equity in access to education.::这项政策旨在改善教育机会的公平性。|She holds a small amount of equity in the company.::她持有公司的一小部分股权。

inequality|/ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti/|n.|不平等；不均衡|六级|civic-practices|income inequality::收入不平等;reduce inequality::减少不平等|The study examines changes in income inequality over time.::这项研究考察收入不平等随时间发生的变化。|Better access to services may help reduce inequality.::更便捷地获得服务可能有助于减少不平等。

allocate|/ˈæləkeɪt/|v.|分配；划拨|六级|allocate|allocate resources::分配资源;allocate time::分配时间|We need to allocate enough time for testing.::我们需要为测试分配足够的时间。|The committee will allocate resources according to local needs.::委员会将根据当地需求分配资源。

allocation|/ˌæləˈkeɪʃən/|n.|分配；分配额|六级|allocate|resource allocation::资源分配;the allocation of funds::资金分配|The report explains the allocation of funds to each project.::报告解释了向各个项目分配资金的情况。|Clear priorities can improve resource allocation.::明确的优先事项能够改善资源分配。

implement|/ˈɪmplɪment/|v.|实施；执行|六级|implement|implement a policy::实施政策;implement a plan::执行计划|The team will implement the plan in three stages.::团队将分三个阶段执行计划。|The city needs time to implement the new policy.::这座城市需要时间来实施新政策。

implementation|/ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃən/|n.|实施；执行；落实|六级|implement|policy implementation::政策实施;successful implementation::成功落实|Successful implementation depends on clear responsibilities.::成功落实取决于明确的职责。|The report identifies problems in the implementation of the plan.::报告指出了计划实施过程中的问题。

accountability|/əˌkaʊntəˈbɪləti/|n.|责任；问责；说明和负责的义务|六级|civic-practices|public accountability::公共问责;accountability for::对……负责|Clear records help improve accountability for public spending.::清晰的记录有助于加强公共支出的问责。|The agreement sets out accountability for each part of the project.::协议规定了项目各部分的责任归属。

transparent|/trænsˈperənt/|adj.|透明的；公开易懂的|六级|transparent|transparent glass::透明玻璃;a transparent process::公开透明的程序|The box has a transparent lid so you can see inside.::盒子有一个透明盖子，可以看到里面。|A transparent process helps people understand how decisions are made.::公开透明的程序帮助人们理解决策是如何作出的。

transparency|/trænsˈperənsi/|n.|透明；公开透明|六级|transparent|greater transparency::更高的透明度;transparency in decision-making::决策透明度|The proposal calls for greater transparency in decision-making.::这项提案要求提高决策透明度。|The material was chosen for its strength and transparency.::选择这种材料是因为它的强度和透明度。

consensus|/kənˈsensəs/|n.|共识；一致意见|六级|civic-practices|reach a consensus::达成共识;a broad consensus::广泛共识|The group reached a consensus after a long discussion.::经过长时间讨论，小组达成了共识。|There is a broad consensus that the service needs improvement.::人们普遍认为这项服务需要改进。

legitimate|/lɪˈdʒɪtəmət/|adj.|正当的；合法的；合理的|六级|legitimate|a legitimate concern::合理的担忧;a legitimate reason::正当理由|Residents have a legitimate concern about traffic noise.::居民对交通噪声的担忧是合理的。|The committee asked whether there was a legitimate reason for the delay.::委员会询问延误是否有正当理由。

legitimacy|/lɪˈdʒɪtəməsi/|n.|正当性；合法性|六级|legitimate|political legitimacy::政治合法性;question the legitimacy::质疑正当性|The debate focused on the legitimacy of the decision.::辩论集中于这一决定的正当性。|Clear procedures can strengthen the legitimacy of an institution.::明确的程序能够增强一个机构的正当性。
